sources.name: Dezeen
sources.summary: Images have been released of the Old Oak Common station in west London, which is currently under construction as part of the high-speed rail network HS2. The design, led by architecture studio WilkinsonEyre and engineering firm WSP, includes six platforms for the HS2 line running between London and central Birmingham, along with eight conventional platforms. The post Construction photos reveal progress on giant HS2 station by WilkinsonEyre appeared first on Dezeen .
